entries.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia
entries.snippet: Russian officials say another 75 people were injured by the attack in the Tatarstan region, one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks on Russia since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

entries.title: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
entries.snippet: Frans Mathipa was shot while driving - we got access to the prosecution case against eight accused men.

entries.title: China evacuates one million from homes as massive storm arrives
entries.snippet: Typhoon Dolphin has made landfall, bringing strong winds and heavy rain across eastern China including Shanghai.

entries.title: Former Thai MP allegedly kills official and confesses on YouTube
entries.snippet: Chalong Riewrang called a YouTube livestream to say he had shot a government official.

entries.title: Alleged rebel leader killed in Colombia as president targets armed groups
entries.snippet: The military operation against Hernando Forero Mosquera was carried out just days after Colombia's new president was sworn in.

entries.title: World's oceans hit record-high July temperatures
entries.snippet: Global oceans recorded their hottest July on record, partly fuelled by developing El Niño conditions, as wildfires continue to ravage western Europe.

entries.title: India police fire tear gas at protesters seeking exam reforms
entries.snippet: Thousands of students and job seekers have gathered in Jharkhand state, weeks after the "cockroach" protests took place in Delhi.

entries.title: 'Body in suitcase' found in Australia turns out to be lifelike doll
entries.snippet: Forensics revealed that the "realistic" looking body was in fact not human.

entries.title: Battle for Mali base has killed dozens of militants, army says
entries.snippet: The army says it was involved in fierce fighting but disputes that Islamists took control of the garrison.

entries.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
entries.snippet: Israel's PM says its military will not pull out from Gaza until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.

entries.title: Suspected crime boss Kinahan spends first night in custody in Ireland
entries.snippet: The Irish Prison Service bought a bulletproof and bombproof van to transport the 49-year-old to court after his extradition from Dubai.

entries.title: Drones spotted over German base days after Leipzig bomb incident
entries.snippet: Police are investigating a drone sighting over a miltary base reportedly used for housing Patriot missile system parts.

entries.title: Ancient Roman shipwreck discovered off Sicily coast
entries.snippet: Italy's culture minister says it is one of the most important underwater archaeological finds in years.

entries.title: Residents warned to brace for the worst as Canada wildfire rages out of control
entries.snippet: One person has died in the Bald Range wildfire in British Columbia which has spread over 53 sq miles.

entries.title: Ecuador charges ex-minister over presidential candidate assassination case
entries.snippet: Prosecutors accuse six others, including the leader of cartel Los Lobos, of having an indirect role in the murder of Fernando Villavicencio.

entries.title: Hundreds arrested over French wildfires, but who is to blame?
entries.snippet: The government is trying to attribute blame for the unprecedented fires which tore through the country last month.

entries.title: Australia is the planet's extinction hotspot, but one animal offers a glimmer of hope
entries.snippet: The country is home to some of the world's most unique species - but it is losing them at an alarming rate.

entries.title: How a schoolteacher's son became Kashmir's first India Test cricketer
entries.snippet: Auqib Nabi becomes Jammu and Kashmir's first cricketer to get India Test call-up, inspiring millions.

entries.title: Nigeria's mass wedding - and how telling lovers from fraudsters is proving tricky
entries.snippet: The scheme is for couples who cannot afford the significant financial costs associated with marriage.

entries.title: How Kinahan's hearing unfolded inside the courtroom in Dublin
entries.snippet: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan appeared in court and was charged with directing the activities of a criminal organisation after being extradited from Dubai.

entries.title: Flood death toll in India's Assam reaches 100 as thousands lose their homes
entries.snippet: Days of heavy monsoon rain has caused rivers, including the Brahmaputra, to overflow, inundating communities, disrupting livelihoods and damaging infrastructure.

entries.title: Decades of abuse revealed at Michigan art school. And, the Iran war's impact on midterms
entries.snippet: A new report has revealed decades of alleged abuse at an elite art school. NPR spoke with one of the victims. And, Iran is playing the long game with negotiations, which could impact midterms.

entries.title: Some disabled people want to advance their careers. They say Medicaid rules stop them
entries.snippet: Medicaid will have new work requirements next year. But some people with disabilities, who already work, say they'd like to work more, but risk losing their Medicaid coverage if they earn too much.

entries.title: Mike Lindell touts Trump ties in race for governor of Minnesota, where Trump has lost
entries.snippet: Lindell, of "MyPillow," plays up his ties to Trump, who endorsed him for Tuesday's primary. But the state Republican convention backed one of his opponents.

entries.title: An arts school where Epstein allegedly preyed on students reveals decades of abuse
entries.snippet: In a new report, former Interlochen students detail some 70 allegations of sexual abuse by nearly 50 adults employed or affiliated with the school. One of the former students tells his story to NPR.

entries.title: In a competitive Maine Senate race, women voters could be the deciders
entries.snippet: The race between Susan Collins and Troy Jackson is one of this year's most high-profile Senate contests. To win, both candidates will need support from an especially powerful voting bloc: Maine women.

entries.title: Voters are sick of the 2-party system. A new poll shows they're open to big changes
entries.snippet: A new poll shows support for moving the U.S. toward proportional representation, a system that elects multiple representatives in a single district in rough proportion to a party's vote share.

entries.title: Who really needs testosterone?
entries.snippet: The military plans to start screening service members for low testosterone, and social media is overflowing with claims about testosterone therapy. But who actually needs it?

entries.title: The FAA wants to reboot the nation's airspace. This airline shows how it might work
entries.snippet: When Alaska Airlines wanted to optimize its operations, it turned to a small startup called Air Space Intelligence. Now the FAA has hired the company for a major reboot of the entire U.S. airspace.

entries.title: Ukrainian drone attack on the Russian city of Nizhnekamsk kills 12, authorities say
entries.snippet: Ukraine has targeted Russian oil facilities with long-range drones almost daily in recent months. The barrage has caused fuel shortages in Russia and unsettled the Russian public.

entries.title: How to spot the Perseid meteor shower, a summer light show that promises to dazzle
entries.snippet: The meteor shower's peak Wednesday night into Thursday morning coincides with a total solar eclipse across Spain, Iceland and Greenland and a six-planet parade — though the best time to view the fireballs will come after totality.

entries.title: Watchdog for $46 billion tribal gambling industry can't enforce the law without a chairperson
entries.snippet: Tribal gambling brought in a record $46 billion in 2025, nearly triple the annual casino revenue of gambling powerhouse Nevada.

entries.title: El-Sayed spoke with Obama as Michigan Democrats look to unite after a bitter Senate primary
entries.snippet: "I was grateful for his advice. It was very warm, very inviting, and I know that he knows the critical role that Michigan is going to play," El-Sayed told NBC's "Meet the Press."

entries.title: Climate change may be making us lonelier. How heat waves and extreme weather disrupt social connections
entries.snippet: As extreme weather becomes more common and disruptive, the effects can impair relationships, interrupt routines and communication, and damage gathering places and the foundations of community traditions.

entries.title: Israel rejects Trump's Gaza plan, more details emerge on the Strait of Hormuz and other Mideast news
entries.snippet: Here's a look at developments across the Middle East.

entries.title: Health officials urge caution for Gulf Coast beachgoers during surge of deadly bacterial infections
entries.snippet: Louisiana has confirmed nine cases of Vibrio vulnificus infections this year, the state's health department said last week in a news release. All were hospitalized, and five died.

entries.title: Trump's immigration crackdown looms over Minnesota's bruising Senate primary
entries.snippet: Months later, confrontations between immigration agents and protestors in Minneapolis remain the backdrop to Minnesota's Democratic primary for U.S. Senate on Tuesday, which features establishment-backed U.S. Rep. Angie Craig and the more progressive Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan.

entries.title: Pilots of helicopter that crashed while fighting wildfire in Utah are dead, officials say
entries.snippet: The pilots were killed when their Sikorsky Skycrane helicopter went down Friday morning, according to the Sevier County Sheriff.

entries.title: Joe Biden's prostate cancer has spread and is causing him pain, Hunter Biden says
entries.snippet: In a wide-ranging interview with the BBC broadcast late on Friday, Hunter Biden grew emotional as he discussed his father's condition, describing it as very sad to watch.

entries.title: Pakistan says new defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey is 'purely defensive' and open to others
entries.snippet: The landmark Mecca Joint Defense Agreement was signed on Friday as the three countries seek to deepen security cooperation amid heightened tensions between the United States and Iran.

entries.title: Wildfires force 20,000 to flee as British Columbia declares state of emergency
entries.snippet: Premier David Eby announced the emergency as more than 100 wildfires burned across the province, nearly half of them out of control in hot, windy weather and prolonged drought.

entries.title: ICE says it expects to equip every field officer with body cameras by the end of August
entries.snippet: The agency defended its body-worn camera policy amid questions about provisions allowing ICE leadership to withhold or indefinitely delay footage after serious injuries or deaths in custody.

entries.title: How Troy Jackson went from Maine logger to Democratic nominee for Senate against Susan Collins
entries.snippet: Jackson's campaign has focused on his ties to Aroostook County, a sprawling, wooded region known as "The County" to Mainers.

entries.title: A New Mexico judge ordered new child safeguards for Meta. Advocates hope other courts follow
entries.snippet: The judge's order showed a possible path forward for other court fights around the country as Meta faces mounting legal, regulatory and public pressure to do more to protect young people.

entries.title: What are Zyn nicotine pouches and are they safe?
entries.snippet: The Food and Drug Administration is allowing the company Zyn to advertise some of its nicotine pouches as safer in some ways than smoking cigarettes.

entries.title: 12-year-old girl dies after Thailand school shooting, bringing death toll to at least 8
entries.snippet: A 14-year-old opened fire at around 10 a.m. Friday at Debsirin Nonthaburi School in Nonthaburi province northwest of the Thai capital before apparently taking his own life.

entries.title: Lake Mead hits historic low water level as Colorado River struggles
entries.snippet: The record follows a winter that produced the worst snowpack on record in the Colorado River Basin.

entries.title: What to know about Trump's new attempt to limit birthright citizenship
entries.snippet: A Supreme Court decision in June struck down a previous attempt at restricting birthright citizenship, but Thursday's orders were made with "adjustments" keeping the decision in mind, President Donald Trump said.

entries.title: Todd Blanche narrowly confirmed as Trump's attorney general in overnight vote
entries.snippet: The Republican-led Senate voted 50-49 to make Blanche the second confirmed attorney general since Trump returned to the White House last year with a stated desire to use the law enforcement agency to investigate his political enemies.

entries.title: Advocates for former U.S. Marine held for years in Russia say he is near death
entries.snippet: A former U.S. Marine held in Russia for more than four years on disputed charges is gravely ill and at risk of dying, his family and advocates said Friday.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: How climate change is reshaping Africa's malaria risk
entries.snippet: Researchers say warming temperatures are altering malaria transmission patterns across Africa, creating new challenges for health systems and disease control.

entries.title: Middle East: Iran wants US concessions before opening Hormuz
entries.snippet: Iran's Foreign Ministry reiterated that the US must meet Tehran's demands before the Strait of Hormuz is reopened and that ships transiting through will be expected to pay a fee. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: ASEAN closing ranks as cyberscam threat escalates
entries.snippet: Southeast Asian governments are searching for a joint strategy against cyberscammers, a criminal industry that has grown too big, too connected and too embedded in ASEAN economies to be solved just by policing.

entries.title: India: Student anger over alleged exam issues spreads to Jharkhand
entries.snippet: Inspired by the Cockroach movement, young people in India's eastern state of Jharkhand are marching on the state assembly to demand transparency and a probe into alleged irregularities in civil service recruitment exams.

entries.title: UEFA, other football federations unite against Infantino
entries.snippet: A few weeks ago, Gianni Infantino looked set for another unopposed term as FIFA president. Now, with an election looming, the beleagured football executive is counting the numbers and could be hanging by a thread.

entries.title: Ukrainian drone attack kills at least 13 in central Russia
entries.snippet: Ukraine launched hundreds of drones at targets inside Russia, according to Russian officials. The strikes killed more than a dozen in one of Kyiv's deadliest attacks since the Russian invasion began over four years ago.

entries.title: Thai ex-lawmaker shoots local official dead over loan
entries.snippet: A former lawmaker confessed to shooting a senior official at a government office over a money dispute, police have said. The incident came just days after Thailand's deadliest shooting in nearly four years.

entries.title: India news: Jharkhand police use tear gas, water cannons to disperse student protesters
entries.snippet: Police used force to disperse students marching towards the Jharkhand assembly, as protests over alleged irregularities in government recruitment exams entered their third week. DW has more.

entries.title: When extreme heat threatens Europe's nuclear power
entries.snippet: Warm rivers and low water levels are forcing nuclear power plants to reduce output across Europe. Over a year, the losses are minimal, but on critical days the loss of power has consequences for grids and prices.

entries.title: China: Typhoon Dolphin prompts mass evacuation, canceled flights
entries.snippet: Even as it weakens, Typhoon Dolphin is disrupting life in China. Close to 1,500 flights have been canceled in Shanghai while parts of Beijing are under flood alert.

entries.title: Germany news: Low water on Rhine could sever freight route
entries.snippet: Germany's inland shipping association has warned that the Rhine could soon become effectively split in two as water levels continue to fall. In Berlin, a man was shot dead near a busy central transport hub. DW has more.

entries.title: Type 2 diabetes in young women increasingly common
entries.snippet: British researchers say rates of type 2 diabetes are growing most among women under 40. The disease is often underdiagnosed in women or diagnosed too late to reverse the condition's progression.

entries.title: Iran War: Is Iran’s middle class being pushed into poverty?
entries.snippet: The war has intensified Iran’s economic crisis, squeezing household budgets, hurting businesses and raising fears that millions of middle-income families are slipping closer to poverty.

entries.title: Western Europe records hottest June and July on record
entries.snippet: Drought is gripping large parts of Europe, with soils unusually dry and major rivers running low. A strengthening El Nino could push global temperatures even higher later this year.

entries.title: Netanyahu, at odds with Trump, rejects Gaza peace plan
entries.snippet: The Israeli prime minister says his country will not withdraw from Gaza until Hamas fully disarms, setting himself against a US-backed roadmap endorsed by the group.

entries.title: Alleged Irish crime boss Kinahan charged with directing criminal organisation
entries.snippet: Daniel Kinahan is accused of leading the Kinahan organised crime group, an international network linked to drug trafficking and money laundering operations,

entries.title: Syria says deal agreed with Russia on future of military bases
entries.snippet: Under the agreement, Syria will take over management of two Russian bases that were used to support ousted leader Bashar Assad during the Syrian civil war.

entries.title: Denmark: Several wounded in suspected gang shooting
entries.snippet: Police said they believed that the incident was linked to a "settling of scores" within criminal networks.

entries.title: Germany news: Berlin to step up drone security research
entries.snippet: Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt said Germany is moving to counter the threats posed by drones. Meanwhile, the transport minister said he wants Deutsche Bahn bonuses tied to punctuality targets.
